Model residents and build standardized predictors (r_js_z, C_js_z, S_js_z)

Source: R/model_residents.R
model_residents.Rd

Builds a GLMM formula, fits the residents-only model, and constructs standardized matrices. Per-site z for both r_js and C_js happens here. If reduce_strategy = "pca", this function expands factors to dummies, standardizes all predictors, and runs PCA on the standardized matrix. The PCA objects plus dummy/centering metadata are stored for robust projection.

Usage

model_residents(
  fit,
  family = glmmTMB::tweedie(link = "log"),
  include_env_trait_interactions = TRUE,
  saturation_mode = c("evenness_deficit", "opportunity_penalty", "modelled_dominance"),
  robust_r = TRUE,
  robust_c = TRUE,
  fit_model = TRUE,
  max_dense_gb = 8,
  reduce_strategy = c("auto", "none", "no_interactions", "pca"),
  pca_env_k = 5,
  pca_trait_k = 5,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

fit

from prepare_trait_space() (must contain inputs + crowding$C_js (raw))

family

glmmTMB family

include_env_trait_interactions

logical; for build_model_formula()

saturation_mode

one of "evenness_deficit","opportunity_penalty","modelled_dominance"

robust_r

logical; robust row-wise z for r_js

robust_c

logical; robust row-wise z for C_js

fit_model

logical; if FALSE, builds/preflights but does not fit

max_dense_gb

numeric; threshold (GB) for dense design size preflight

reduce_strategy

one of c("auto","none","no_interactions","pca")

pca_env_k,

pca_trait_k integers; number of PCs if PCA reduction is used

verbose

logical; emit messages

Value

updated invasimapr_fit
